about: Photos for UNIQLO products Fynd lists without one, found on UNIQLO's own image host by scripts/find-uniqlo-photos.js (GitHub Actions run 39082168769, 2026-10-18). Each address carries the product's own code (…/imagesgoods/<code>/item/goods_<colour>_<code>_3x4.jpg) and answered with an image, so it is that product's photo, in colour 09.
